review_comments: `switchport mode trunk` needs to be added.

since the cfg file already have [switchport mode trunk](https://github.com/ansible/ansible/blob/devel/test/units/modules/network/eos/fixtures/eos_l2_interfaces_config.cfg#L6), the command is not fired.

When switchport mode is access, it does not appear in running config for an eos device. I think the behavior is similar in NXOS as well. This has to be handled in order to maintain the idempotent state.
Thanks for the update, I have documented the behavior under eos module documentation as well, for NXOS it's already updated.
